anti_patterns.remediation: Declare explicit least-privilege 'permissions:' (for example, contents: read) at the workflow or job level.

anti_patterns.message: Job 'binary' omits 'timeout-minutes', risking 360-minute hung runners.
anti_patterns.remediation: Set an explicit 'timeout-minutes:' value on every job (for example, timeout-minutes: 15).

anti_patterns.message: Job 'docker-rootful' omits 'timeout-minutes', risking 360-minute hung runners.
anti_patterns.remediation: Set an explicit 'timeout-minutes:' value on every job (for example, timeout-minutes: 15).

anti_patterns.message: Job 'docker-rootless' omits 'timeout-minutes', risking 360-minute hung runners.
anti_patterns.remediation: Set an explicit 'timeout-minutes:' value on every job (for example, timeout-minutes: 15).

anti_patterns.message: Job 'binary' step 10 uses cloud authentication without OIDC 'id-token: write' or relies on static cloud keys.
anti_patterns.remediation: Configure short-lived OIDC federation with 'permissions: id-token: write' and replace long-lived static cloud keys.
